outcome: deletion of 11.9 Mb at 3q13.2q21.2 comprising 80 genes
cohort: A single male patient previously diagnosed with MOMO syndrome presented with atypical clinical manifestations.
finding: Whole-genome sequencing detected a deletion of 11.9 Mb at 3q13.2q21.2 in a patient with MOMO syndrome and atypical features, leading to the hypothesis that MOMO syndrome could be part of the Primrose/3q13.31 microdeletion syndrome spectrum.
